title: Cap exponential retry delay without overflow
prompt: Start at min(base, cap). Double once per failure, stopping at cap. Return zero when base or cap is zero. Avoid unsigned overflow, even for a very large failure count. This deterministic calculation omits jitter on purpose.
signature: std::size_t retryDelay(unsigned failures, std::size_t base, std::size_t cap)

tests.label: No failures
tests.hint: The initial delay is not doubled yet.

tests.label: Cap reached
tests.hint: Saturate rather than exceeding the cap.

tests.label: Huge count
tests.hint: Stop growing once the cap is reached.

hints: Before doubling, compare delay with cap/2.
Once delay reaches cap, later failures cannot change the answer.
explanation: Saturating growth prevents a large unsigned value from wrapping into a short delay. The early stop also avoids looping through a huge failure count.
